_comment: Political intrigue (scripts/politics.gd). roles: the officials each port can have (ports pick theirs in 'offices'). groups: interest groups; their influence sets the port's laws (vigilance against smuggling and false colours, tariff on trade, pirates: -1 hang them all .. +1 welcome, pardon: cheaper pardons). influence: starting influence by nation. favours: what calling in a favour does (outcomes use the event language, docs/events.md). secrets: what can be learned and about whom. council: the pirate council of Nassau.

planters.name: Planters
planters.description: Sugar and tobacco estates. Want cheap goods and labour, and don't ask where either came from.

merchants.name: Merchants
merchants.description: Shipowners and traders. Pirates rob them; smugglers undercut them.

military.name: Military
military.description: The garrison and the navy's friends. Order, patrols, and the gallows for pirates.

church.name: Church
church.description: Priests and the pious. Hard on sin, soft on repentant sinners.

poor.name: Townsfolk
poor.description: Sailors, tavern keepers, labourers. Pirates spend money here.

pull_strings.name: Smooth things over with the Crown
pull_strings.description: A quiet word in the right ear: standing with this nation +15.

pardon.name: A pardon, signed and sealed
pardon.description: Forgiveness without the fee. Every other effect of a pardon still applies.

blind_eye.name: A blind eye in the harbour
blind_eye.description: For two months this port lets you in whatever your name or standing.

patrol_warning.name: Where the patrols will be
patrol_warning.description: For a month this nation's warships won't find you unless you go looking for them.

market_tip.name: The prices in every port
market_tip.description: His agents' letters: today's prices for everything, everywhere.

sanctuary.name: A blessing and a sermon
sanctuary.description: A Mass for the crew and a word for your soul: morale +10 for a month, honour +2.

fresh_hands.name: Men who need a ship
fresh_hands.description: Eight hands who'll sign on, no questions asked and no bounty to pay.

letters.name: Private letters
letters.text: Private letters in {name}'s hand, full of things no {role} should ever have written.

ledger.name: A smuggling ledger
ledger.text: A ledger proving {name} trades in contraband behind the customs house's back.

bribes.name: Proof of bribery
bribes.text: Receipts showing {name} takes money to look the other way.

schedule.name: A sailing schedule
schedule.text: The sailing dates and course of {name}'s richest ship. Worth something until she sails.

punish.name: Punish a captain who broke the code
